mutants.category: MIPI D-PHY v2.5 / WAITEDGE Rising Edge Synchronization
mutants.description: MIPI D-PHY v2.5 SoT sync edge synchronization bug: WAITEDGE rising-edge mode (2'b01) evaluates falling edge condition (edge_fall instead of edge_rise), causing slave receiver SoT sync detection on Dp to hang or trigger on illegal polarity
